regions.today: Today will be mostly cloudy across Connacht with outbreaks of rain and drizzle. This evening, drier weather with some bright intervals will extend from the west. Highest temperatures of 16 to 18 degrees with light to moderate southwest breezes.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be mild and mainly dry with a fair amount of cloud and some clear breaks. Some mist and fog patches may develop. Temperatures will not fall below 12 to 15 degrees with mostly light westerly breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Monday will be warm, humid and mostly cloudy with some rain or drizzle at times. Towards evening, rain will become heavier in the west and will move eastwards through the evening. Highest temperatures of 17 to 21 degrees with light to moderate westerly winds.
